Jeremy Twogood — Multimedia Producer & Video Editor
Website: https://jeremytwogood.com
Location: Ontario, Canada

Jeremy Twogood is a full-service multimedia producer and video editor with over a decade of experience crafting films, ads, and branded content. His primary work is video editing, motion graphics, colour grading, aerial videography, and animation. He also builds AI-powered tools and software applications as a secondary creative practice.

Notable clients include Google, Microsoft Xbox, Shell, Sony Ericsson, Sobeys, Volvo, Mitsubishi Motors, Irish Productions, and Canova Media.

AI and software projects include The Gibbon Knight, Rome Brone, Unbusy App, and Bike App — all built using the Claude API and related technologies.

Skills: Video Editing, Motion Graphics, Colour Grading, Aerial Videography, Animation, AI Tooling, Claude API, Software Development.
